en.primary_text: Exciting opportunity for Class A drivers to join our dynamic team. We offer competitive pay, great freight and a family atmosphere where we truly value our drivers. Earn $0.62/mile. Apply today and take your career to the next level.

scores.reason: The pay slot gives the figure, but primary_text opens with "Exciting opportunity" and the headline is "Great pay, great team". Nothing says reefer, Chicago to Texas, home weekly or Silvicom. The Spanish is a word-for-word copy of the same brochure lines.

The pay slot and the opening of primary_text lead with a figure and then who it is for, in plain talk. But it describes flatbed and home weekends, not the reefer subject, and names no route and no carrier. "Join our team" is filler, and the Spanish drops it, adds "con experiencia" and uses the odd "fines en casa".

The pay slot leads with the figure and the headline says who it is for, though primary_text holds the pay to the end. It names reefer, Chicago to Texas and back, home weekly, no-touch and Silvicom, with no filler. The Spanish uses trade words, but "Comenzando en... llegando hasta" is stiff and the es headline and primary_text run long.
